import unittest
from src.template import escape_html
class TestXSS(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_escape(self):
        raw = '<script>alert("XSS")</script>&foo'
        escaped = escape_html(raw)
        self.assertNotIn('<script>', escaped)
        self.assertIn('<script>', escaped)
        self.assertIn('&foo', escaped)
if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

        salt = 'secretsalt123'
        h = hash_password('mypassword', salt)
